subject.title: [Feature]: Telegram — full agent activity visibility (Web UI parity)

question: Should Telegram gain a persistent per-step activity-message mode, and what redaction, retention, group/DM, and configuration policy should it use?
rationale: Current main intentionally provides transient editable previews and sanitized browser-local Activity summaries; making Telegram persist every activity step changes disclosure, retention, message volume, and public config behavior that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Design redacted opt-in mode
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved Telegram mode only after specifying safe defaults, allowed step types, redaction rules, retention semantics, and live Telegram proof requirements.

options.title: Keep current previews
options.body: Leave Telegram on editable progress drafts plus final answers and decline durable per-step activity messages for now.

options.title: Create shared observer API first
options.body: Design a channel-safe observer stream/API before adding Telegram-specific persistent rendering so Web UI, TUI, and Telegram do not drift.

recommendation.title: Design redacted opt-in mode
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved Telegram mode only after specifying safe defaults, allowed step types, redaction rules, retention semantics, and live Telegram proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current history on Telegram progress-window behavior and adjacent collapse-summary implementation.
